title: All Season, 75% White Down, 25% White Feather, Comforter, White, by Dreamhood
text: All Season, 75% White Down, 25% White Feather, Comforter, White, by Dreamhood. I should have realized when it said "ALL SEASON" that it may be too Hot for Summer and too Cold for Winter. It is my first Down comforter so I will chock it up to inexperience in the product. I thought when it arrived and the package was smaller than I thought a comforter should be that it was vacuum packed, but it was also very light Weight: 5.74 pounds. It just isn't as substantial, isn't as plush & fluffy as I was expecting. I am probably not going to keep it for this reason but also since I ordered it I have read how the Down products are acquired and I don't think in this day and age I need to support a product harvested from potentially live Geese. Full/Queen 88 x 88 inches. As with ALL Down products you should Dry clean and spot clean only.
